Refresh the country inventory

Source: R/jobs.R
soil_refresh_countries.Rd

Queues the recomputation of the daily country totals read by soil_countries() (POST /countries/refresh). The job runs on the server; follow it with soil_job_wait() (which needs soil:publish).

Usage

soil_refresh_countries(soil = soil_session(), idempotency_key = NULL)

Arguments

soil

A session; the default session when omitted. Client-side: not sent to the API.

idempotency_key

Optional key: a second request with the same key returns the job already queued instead of queuing another one. API query parameter idempotency_key.

Value

The queued soil_job (unified view).

Details

Rights: soil:admin.

See also

Other jobs: soil_job(), soil_job_cancel(), soil_job_wait()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
job <- soil_refresh_countries(soil, idempotency_key = "countries-2026-10-18")
soil_job_wait(soil, job$job_id)
} # }
